record.name: Benin
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Benin's AI and Big Data Strategy 2023-2027 calls for an AI ethics and accountability text and, in time, an AI regulatory body, but sets up no model evaluation institute.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The retrieved national AI strategy discusses governance, accountability/ethics, regulation and a sandbox; these do not designate a technical institute for the safety of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.governance_note: The retrieved national AI and big-data strategy sets ethics/accountability work and prospective AI regulation; no qualifying mandate to evaluate advanced models is identified.

related_bodies.name: Agence des Systèmes d'Information et du Numérique (ASIN)
related_bodies.role: It contributes to implementing AI projects under the strategy; it is not an evaluation body.

related_bodies.name: Autorité de Protection des Données Personnelles (APDP)
related_bodies.role: It protects personal data and privacy as an independent authority. No national mandate to evaluate advanced models was identified in the retrieved mission statement.

record.notes: Primary source is the strategy document hosted by the national information systems agency (ASIN), read in full text. It refers to creating an AI regulation body at a later stage without defining a mandate. Searched in French and English; the Ministry of Digital Affairs site did not surface.

next_check.reason: the 2023-2027 strategy ends in 2027; check for a successor strategy or an AI regulator.
